description: This file defines an interface for a grain observer in Orleans, providing asynchronous methods for various test scenarios such as happy path, sad path, serial stress, and parallel stress.

classes.name: IClientAddressableTestClientObject
classes.description: An interface extending IGrainObserver, with asynchronous methods for testing purposes.

methods.name: OnHappyPath
methods.description: An asynchronous method that accepts a string message and returns a Task of string.

methods.name: OnSadPath
methods.description: An asynchronous method that accepts a string message and returns a Task.

methods.name: OnSerialStress
methods.description: An asynchronous method taking an integer for serial stress testing and returning a Task of int.

methods.name: OnParallelStress
methods.description: An asynchronous method taking an integer for parallel stress testing and returning a Task of int.
